metaTitle: Custom Puffer Nursing Scrubs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom puffer nursing scrubs with your logo. Warm, durable, and perfect for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Puffer nursing scrubs combine the professional look of medical uniforms with the warmth of insulated outerwear. Designed for nurses who work in cold clinical environments or travel between buildings, these scrubs feature quilted padding that retains body heat without restricting movement. Choose from several pocket configurations and decoration methods like embroidery or screen printing to add your facility's logo. Bulk orders ensure consistent sizing and color matching across your team.
heroAltText: Group of medical professionals wearing custom puffer nursing scrubs with embroidered logos in a hospital hallway
